svn.description.en: Reads repository objects at a pinned revision without checkout.
svn.description.zh-CN: 无需 checkout，读取指定版本的仓库对象。

svn.field.trust.description.en: Empty means the server's certificate must verify. A self-signed or internal server lists the failures to accept instead: unknown-ca, cn-mismatch, expired, not-yet-valid, or other for anything else. Everything listed here is a promise this source makes about its own network.
svn.field.trust.description.zh-CN: 留空表示必须验证服务器证书。自签名或内部服务器在此列出要接受的错误：unknown-ca、cn-mismatch、expired、not-yet-valid，或 other 表示其余全部。列在这里的每一项，都是这个来源对自己所在网络作出的承诺。

svn.field.insecure.description.en: A plain http:// repository is refused unless insecure transport is accepted for this source; anything that carries an account should stay on https.
svn.field.insecure.description.zh-CN: 除非明确允许这个来源使用不加密的连接，https 以外的 http:// 仓库会被拒绝；任何涉及账号的仓库都应留在 https 上。

svn.field.credential.description.en: Which account this repository uses. Leave it unchosen to use what the Subversion client already saved for this machine. A repository behind mutual TLS uses a certificate credential.
svn.field.credential.description.zh-CN: 这个仓库用哪个账号。不选则使用 Subversion 客户端在本机已保存的账号。要求客户端证书的仓库请选择证书类型的凭据。

svn.credential.cached.description.en: Uses the account TortoiseSVN or the svn command line already saved on this machine, so no password is typed into PolyMount. Name whose cache to read: Windows protects the saved password with that account's own key, so the service borrows its identity for the length of the read.
svn.credential.cached.description.zh-CN: 使用 TortoiseSVN 或 svn 命令行在本机已保存的账号，不必在 PolyMount 里输入密码。指定读哪个账户的缓存：Windows 用该账户自己的密钥保护保存的密码，服务在读取的那一刻借用该账户的身份。

svn.credential.cached.account.descriptio.en: Whose TortoiseSVN cache to read, for example your own Windows account name. The cache can only be opened while that account is signed in on this machine, and only by a service running as LocalSystem. Leave it empty for the account the service runs as.
svn.credential.cached.account.descriptio.zh-CN: 读哪个账户的 TortoiseSVN 缓存，例如你登录 Windows 的账户名。只有该账户在本机处于登录状态时才能解开，且要求服务以 LocalSystem 运行。留空表示服务运行所用的账户。

svn.credential.cached.account.placeholde.en: The account the service runs as

svn.field.prefetch.concurrency.descripti.en: Directories fetched ahead of demand; 0 disables read-ahead. How many of them reach the source at once is the read-ahead share below.
svn.field.prefetch.concurrency.descripti.zh-CN: 提前抓取的目录数；0 表示关闭预取。其中同时到达源的数量由下面的预取份额决定。

svn.field.prefetch.queue.description.en: Directories that may wait for a worker; later ones are dropped.
svn.field.prefetch.queue.description.zh-CN: 可排队的目录数，超出的会被丢弃。

svn.field.prefetch.children.description.en: Child directories taken from one listing.
svn.field.prefetch.children.description.zh-CN: 每个目录清单预取的子目录数。

svn.field.lane.description.en: Source requests read-ahead may reach at once; one is always kept for it, and the rest of the source is the reader's. This also bounds the read-ahead workers above.
svn.field.lane.description.zh-CN: 预取最多同时占用的源请求数；始终为它保留一条，其余留给读取方。它同时也限制了上面的预取并发数。

svn.action.refreshHead.confirmation.en: Move this layer to HEAD and put that revision into the pinned revision field? Saving makes it the pin.
svn.action.refreshHead.confirmation.zh-CN: 将此层更新到 HEAD，并把该版本填入固定 revision？保存后成为固定版本。
